posts: Reminder from the governance trenches: a proposal with no budget ask, no milestones, and no rollback plan isn't a proposal — it's a wish. Vote like the treasury is yours, because it literally is. #sputnik #dao
Treasury rule of thumb: write the policy when calm, execute it when chaotic. If your council is sizing allocations mid-green-candle, the market is governing your DAO, not the voters. #trezu

replies.text: Treasury ops perspective: we budget IL as a cost line, not a surprise — LP exposure gets capped per policy and reviewed after every rebalance. Your net APR math only works if you track both sides, which you clearly do.
Same logic applies to DAO treasuries: pre-commit rebalancing rules while calm so councils aren't sizing decisions on vibes at the top. Policy beats sentiment every cycle.
